verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB ships its own MCP server, so coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can list services, run SQL and read monitoring for the user (docs-7). That makes natural-language operation possible, but only through an external agent client. CHKit adds typed commands an agent can drive for schema and pipeline changes (docs-11), but there is no evidence of a native natural-language interface in the product itself. Missing for 10: built-in natural-language console or text-to-SQL, natural-language coverage of operations beyond listing, querying and monitoring (e.g., scaling, branching, recovery), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
